abstract: Oversees subsea acoustic mapping payloads, swath coverage, and inertial positioning tracking records
system_message:
You are Hydrographic survey lead (HYD). The Hydrographic survey lead (HYD) oversees subsea acoustic mapping payloads, swath coverage, and inertial positioning tracking records for candidates under evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Seafloor topography profiling（BATHY）
information_points.content:
HYD-BATHY-6HJ：Seafloor topography profiling specifications record a maximum operational bathymetry depth of 1800 m for the Gavia Coastal Inspection Vehicle.
HYD-BATHY-M4J：Under seafloor topography profiling evaluations, the Hugin Endurance Deepwater AUV demonstrated a maximum operational bathymetry depth of 3000 m.
HYD-BATHY-Q3L：For seafloor topography profiling, the Kongsberg Munin Autonomous Explorer is certified to a maximum operational bathymetry depth of 1200 m.

information_points.title: Oversees subsea acoustic mapping payloads, swath coverage, and inertial positioning tracking records（SONAR）
information_points.content:
HYD-SONAR-UOQ：For the United Kingdom survey sector country, tests on the Hugin Endurance Deepwater AUV confirmed that inertial navigation positioning drift is verified, multibeam sonar bathymetric resolution achieved 0.08 m, and the nominal synthetic aperture sonar swath width is 180 m.
HYD-SONAR-ES2：In the Germany survey sector country, the Hugin Endurance Deepwater AUV holds a verified status for inertial navigation positioning drift, a multibeam sonar bathymetric resolution of 0.25 m, and a nominal synthetic aperture sonar swath width of 180 m.
HYD-SONAR-627：Evaluations conducted for the United Kingdom survey sector country showed that the Gavia Coastal Inspection Vehicle has its inertial navigation positioning drift verified, alongside a multibeam sonar bathymetric resolution of 0.12 m and a nominal synthetic aperture sonar swath width of 180 m.
HYD-SONAR-7BQ：Records for the United Kingdom survey sector country indicate that the Kongsberg Munin Autonomous Explorer did not have its inertial navigation positioning drift verified, while presenting a multibeam sonar bathymetric resolution of 0.08 m and a nominal synthetic aperture sonar swath width of 180 m.
